entities.summary: Kyle Lindsay Allman Jr. is a Montenegrin naturalized, American-born professional basketball player for Türk Telekom of the Turkish Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroCup. He played college basketball for the Cal State Fullerton Titans.
